versos.grego: Ὅλως ἀκούεται ἐν ὑμῖν πορνεία, καὶ τοιαύτη πορνεία ἥτις οὐδὲ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ὥστε γυναῖκά τινα τοῦ πατρὸς ἔχειν.

controles.web: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.
controles.kjv: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father’s wife.
controles.livre: Totalmente se ouve que há entre vós pecados sexuais, e tais pecados sexuais que nem mesmo entre os gentioshá ,  como alguém que tomou como mulher a esposa de seu pai.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑμεῖς πεφυσιωμένοι ἐστέ, καὶ οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἐπενθήσατε, ἵνα ἀρθῇ ἐκ μέσου ὑμῶν ὁ τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο πράξας;

controles.web: You are puffed up, and didn’t rather mourn, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.
controles.kjv: And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.
controles.livre: E vós estais orgulhosos! Ao invés disso, vós não deveríeis se entristecer, para que fosse tirado do meio de vós o que cometeu esta atitude?

versos.grego: ἐγὼ μὲν γάρ, ἀπὼν τῷ σώματι παρὼν δὲ τῷ πνεύματι, ἤδη κέκρικα ὡς παρὼν τὸν οὕτως τοῦτο κατεργασάμενον

controles.web: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.
controles.kjv: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,
controles.livre: Porque eu, agindo como ausente de corpo, porém presente de espírito, já julguei como se estivesse presente, aquele que fez isto,

versos.grego: ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ συναχθέντων ὑμῶν καὶ τοῦ ἐμοῦ πνεύματος σὺν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, you being gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
controles.kjv: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when ye are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
controles.livre: No nome do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, quando vós vos reunirdes, e o meu espírito junto de vós, com o poder de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,

versos.grego: παραδοῦναι τὸν τοιοῦτον τῷ Σατανᾷ εἰς ὄλεθρον τῆς σαρκός, ἵνα τὸ πνεῦμα σωθῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου.

controles.web: are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
controles.kjv: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
controles.livre: De ao tal entregar a Satanás, para destruição da carne, para que o espírito seja salvo, no dia do Senhor Jesus.

versos.grego: Οὐ καλὸν τὸ καύχημα ὑμῶν. οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι μικρὰ ζύμη ὅλον τὸ φύραμα ζυμοῖ;

controles.web: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
controles.kjv: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
controles.livre: Vosso orgulho não é bom. Não sabeis que um pouco de fermento faz levedar toda a massa?

versos.grego: ἐκκαθάρατε τὴν παλαιὰν ζύμην, ἵνα ἦτε νέον φύραμα, καθώς ἐστε ἄζυμοι. καὶ γὰρ τὸ πάσχα ἡμῶν ἐτύθη Χριστός.

controles.web: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.
controles.kjv: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:
controles.livre: Limpai pois o velho fermento, para que sejais nova massa, assim como vós sois de fato sem fermento. Porque Cristo, nosso cordeiro da páscoa, foi sacrificado por nós.

versos.grego: ὥστε ἑορτάζωμεν, μὴ ἐν ζύμῃ παλαιᾷ μηδὲ ἐν ζύμῃ κακίας καὶ πονηρίας, ἀλλ’ ἐν ἀζύμοις εἰλικρινίας καὶ ἀληθείας.

controles.web: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
controles.kjv: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
controles.livre: Portanto façamos festa, não no velho fermento, nem no fermento do mal e da perversão, mas em pães não levedados de sinceridade e de verdade.

versos.grego: Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ ἐπιστολῇ μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι πόρνοις,

controles.web: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;
controles.kjv: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:
controles.livre: Eu já vos escrevi por carta, que não vos mistureis com pecadores sexuais.

versos.grego: οὐ πάντως τοῖς πόρνοις τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἢ τοῖς πλεονέκταις καὶ ἅρπαξιν ἢ εἰδωλολάτραις, ἐπεὶ ὠφείλετε ἄρα ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελθεῖν.

controles.web: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters; for then you would have to leave the world.
controles.kjv: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world.
controles.livre: Porém não totalmente com os pecadores deste mundo, ou com os gananciosos, ou ladrões, ou com os idólatras; porque então vos seria necessário sair do mundo.

versos.grego: νῦν δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι ἐάν τις ἀδελφὸς ὀνομαζόμενος ᾖ πόρνος ἢ πλεονέκτης ἢ εἰδωλολάτρης ἢ λοίδορος ἢ μέθυσος ἢ ἅρπαξ, τῷ τοιούτῳ μηδὲ συνεσθίειν.

controles.web: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.
controles.kjv: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.
controles.livre: Mas agora vos escrevo, que não vos mistureis se alguém, chamando a si de irmão, for pecador sexual, ou ganancioso, ou idólatra, ou maldizente, ou beberrão, ou ladrão. Com o tal nem mesmo comais.

versos.grego: τί γάρ μοι τοὺς ἔξω κρίνειν; οὐχὶ τοὺς ἔσω ὑμεῖς κρίνετε;

controles.web: For what have I to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?
controles.kjv: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within?
controles.livre: Por que eu tenho que julgar também aos que estão de fora? Não julgais vós aos que estão de dentro?

versos.grego: τοὺς δὲ ἔξω ὁ Θεὸς κρινεῖ. ἐξάρατε τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν.

controles.web: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”
controles.kjv: But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.
controles.livre: Mas Deus julga aos que estão de fora. Tirai pois dentre vós a este maligno.
